IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Sump, B. Sullivan, Kretz, McCune and Dunn

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a heating oil sales and use tax exemption.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions of heating oil;adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 82.12 RCW; providing an effective date; and declaring anemergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 shall not apply to sales ofheating oil used to heat a home. (2) For the purposes of this section, "heating oil" means anypetroleum product used for space heating in oilfired furnaces,heaters, and boilers, including stove oil, diesel fuel, or kerosene."Heating oil" does not include petroleum products used as fuels inmotor vehicles, marine vessels, trains, buses, aircraft, or any offhighway equipment not used for space heating, or for industrialprocessing or the generation of electrical energy.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter shall not apply with respect tothe use of heating oil used to heat a home. (2) For the purposes of this section, "heating oil" means anypetroleum product used for space heating in oilfired furnaces,heaters, and boilers, including stove oil, diesel fuel, or kerosene."Heating oil" does not include petroleum products used as fuels inmotor vehicles, marine vessels, trains, buses, aircraft, or any offhighway equipment not used for space heating, or for industrialprocessing or the generation of electrical energy.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2007.
